attr.title: The Cat Lady
attr.desc: Native AArch64 port of the psychological horror adventure The Cat Lady, running on an open-source Adventure Game Studio engine. No x86 emulation. Requires you to copy the data files from your own legally-owned copy of the game.
attr.inst: This port does NOT include the game. You must own The Cat Lady (Steam app 253110). Copy these files from your installed copy into: /roms/ports/thecatlady/gamedata/  -> TheCatLady.ags (Linux) OR TheCatLady.exe (Windows), plus TheCatLady.001/.002 if present, audio.vox, speech.vox, and any *.tra languages (e.g. Portuguese.tra). Do NOT copy ags32/ags64/lib32/lib64. See README.md.
